subject: Neurology
vignette: A 9-year-old with bacterial sinusitis develops severe right eye pain that worsens with eye movement, double vision, and progressive loss of vision. There is swelling and erythema of the eyelid and restricted ocular motility. The clinician is concerned about an infection of the orbital contents with risk of intracranial extension.
question: Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis and causative organism?

options.text: Orbital cellulitis; Staphylococcus aureus and streptococci

explanation_correct: Orbital cellulitis is a posterior eyelid infection involving the orbital fat and muscles, usually secondary to bacterial sinusitis. It causes pain with ocular movement, diplopia, and risk of vision loss, cavernous sinus thrombosis, and intracranial spread. It is most commonly caused by Staphylococcus aureus and streptococci, matching this patient's sinusitis and severe findings.

explanation_incorrect.A: Preseptal cellulitis is an anterior eyelid infection with mild pain, swelling, and erythema at rest but no pain with eye movement, diplopia, or vision loss.
explanation_incorrect.B: Blepharitis is inflammation of the lid margin with irritation and crusting, not a deep orbital infection with visual loss.
explanation_incorrect.D: A chalazion is a noninfectious granulomatous inflammation from a blocked meibomian gland, not an acute infection with sinusitis.
explanation_incorrect.E: A hordeolum is an acute localized infection of an eyelid gland producing a tender nodule, not a diffuse postseptal orbital infection.

educationalObjective: Orbital cellulitis is a postseptal infection, often from sinusitis, causing painful ophthalmoplegia and vision loss, typically from S aureus and streptococci.

subject: Neurology
vignette: A 25-year-old woman has a tender, erythematous nodule at the margin of the upper eyelid that appeared over two days. It is an acute infection of one of the sebaceous glands of the eyelid.
question: Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation_correct: A hordeolum, or stye, is an acute infection of the sebaceous or sweat glands of the eyelid and presents as a tender, erythematous nodule. This acute painful gland infection matches the description. A chalazion, in contrast, is a noninfectious granuloma that is typically painless.

explanation_incorrect.B: A chalazion is a painless, noninfectious granulomatous inflammation caused by obstruction of a meibomian or Zeis gland, not an acute tender infection.
explanation_incorrect.C: Xanthelasma appears as yellowish patches on the medial eyelids and is associated with high cholesterol, not an acute tender nodule.
explanation_incorrect.D: Blepharitis produces diffuse lid margin inflammation, irritation, and crusting rather than a single acute tender nodule.
explanation_incorrect.E: Preseptal cellulitis is a diffuse anterior eyelid infection with pain, swelling, and erythema at rest, not a focal glandular nodule.

educationalObjective: A hordeolum is an acute painful infection of an eyelid sebaceous or sweat gland (a stye).

subject: Neurology
vignette: A 35-year-old man has a painless, slowly enlarging nodule on the upper eyelid. Histology shows granulomatous inflammation surrounding a blocked gland. There are no signs of acute infection such as tenderness or erythema.
question: Which of the following best describes this lesion?

options.text: An acute infection of a sweat gland
A yellowish cholesterol-rich plaque on the medial eyelid
A diffuse inflammation of the lid margin with crusting
A posterior orbital infection secondary to sinusitis
A noninfectious granuloma from obstruction of a meibomian or Zeis gland

explanation_correct: A chalazion is a noninfectious granulomatous inflammation caused by obstruction of a meibomian (modified sebaceous) gland or a Zeis (sebaceous) gland. It typically presents as a painless nodule, distinguishing it from the tender, acutely infected hordeolum. The granulomatous histology and absence of infection support this diagnosis.

explanation_incorrect.A: An acute sweat or sebaceous gland infection is a hordeolum, which is tender and erythematous rather than a painless granuloma.
explanation_incorrect.B: A yellowish plaque on the medial eyelid is xanthelasma, associated with high cholesterol, not a granulomatous nodule.
explanation_incorrect.C: Diffuse lid margin inflammation with crusting describes blepharitis, not a focal obstructed gland.
explanation_incorrect.D: A posterior orbital infection from sinusitis is orbital cellulitis, which causes pain with eye movement, diplopia, and vision loss.

educationalObjective: A chalazion is a painless noninfectious granuloma caused by obstruction of a meibomian or Zeis gland.

subject: Neurology
vignette: A 55-year-old woman has flat, yellowish patches on the medial aspects of both upper eyelids. The lesions are asymptomatic and have slowly enlarged over years. Laboratory testing shows elevated serum cholesterol.
question: Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
explanation_correct: Xanthelasma presents as yellowish patches on the medial eyelids and may be associated with genetic and lifestyle factors such as high cholesterol. The bilateral, asymptomatic, flat yellowish plaques in this patient with hypercholesterolemia are characteristic. Unlike a hordeolum or chalazion, it is not a gland-centered tender or granulomatous nodule.

explanation_incorrect.A: A chalazion is a painless granuloma from an obstructed meibomian gland, appearing as a focal nodule rather than flat bilateral yellowish patches.
explanation_incorrect.C: A hordeolum is an acute, tender, erythematous infection of an eyelid gland, not flat painless plaques.
explanation_incorrect.D: Orbital cellulitis is an acute deep infection causing painful eye movement, diplopia, and possible vision loss, not chronic asymptomatic plaques.
explanation_incorrect.E: Blepharitis causes lid margin inflammation, irritation, and crusting rather than discrete yellowish plaques.

educationalObjective: Xanthelasma consists of yellowish medial eyelid patches that may signal hypercholesterolemia.
